# ADR 0003: Limit depth, page size and complexity; disable introspection in production

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** Company financials GraphQL API

## Context

GraphQL lets clients write expensive queries.

## Decision

Instrumentation for max depth 6 and complexity, max page size 100, request timeout; introspection off in prod.

## Consequences

Protected server. Some legitimate deep queries need redesign.

## Alternatives considered

Rate limiting alone.
